tasks.title: Exercise run, 15 to 20 minutes under light load
tasks.note: Keeps the carburetor clean and the battery charged. Outdoors only, 20 feet from the house.

tasks.title: Oil change
tasks.note: Or every 100 hours of use, whichever comes first. First change after the first 20 to 30 hours.

tasks.title: Air filter and spark plug check
Fuel check: stabilizer in, or rotate the gas
Test the CO alarm nearest where the cord comes in
Top up to 60 to 80 percent
tasks.note: Lithium cells stored flat die early. Check every 3 months.

tasks.title: Test an output and the flashlight
Visual check: gauge in the green, pin in place, no damage
tasks.source: NFPA 10 via state fire marshal guidance

tasks.title: Annual maintenance check
tasks.note: Shake dry-chemical units to loosen powder. Replace disposable units 12 years after the manufacture date.

tasks.title: Press the test button
Replace the battery
tasks.note: Skip if it is a sealed 10-year unit.

tasks.title: Press the test button
Replace the battery
Open it, replace used and expired items
tasks.note: The kit's date is the first item to expire.

tasks.title: Review contents, swap seasonal clothes, test lights
tasks.note: Tie it to the clock change in spring and fall.

tasks.title: Seasonal swap: blankets and scraper in, water out of the heat
Test the jump pack and flashlight
Replace the filter element
tasks.note: Follow the manufacturer's gallon rating if you track it.

tasks.title: Check the requalification stamp and valve for rust
tasks.note: 20 lb cylinders need requalification 12 years after manufacture, then every 5 years.

tasks.title: Rotate the fuel into a vehicle and refill fresh
Bucket test: pour water in until it kicks on
Replace the backup battery
Switch it on, check for corroded batteries
Tune to the weather band, crank or charge it
Start it, check chain tension and bar oil
Storage prep: drain fuel, clean and oil the chain
Test start, check the tip-over and low-oxygen shutoff
